description: Create a standalone script to validate twoslash code examples in documentation without requiring a full build. This tool should parse markdown files, extract code blocks with twoslash annotations, and verify their correctness to ensure documentation examples remain accurate.
functional_requirements: Create a script that can be run via pnpm check-twoslash to validate documentation code examples
Parse markdown files from docs and blog directories to extract twoslash-annotated code blocks
Implement per-block validation logic that checks each code example individually for correctness
Integrate with the existing remark/unified toolchain for consistent markdown processing
Output clear validation results indicating which examples pass or fail with specific error messages
Make the checker runnable both locally for developers and in CI environments
